headline: Clean waist-high morning on a prime angle — log it early, then watch midweek light up.
today: Small but well-shaped SE swell on the prime angle, and the NNE-to-NE cross-off holds through the morning so it'll be groomed. Log or fish on the early side; the tide range out here is tiny so don't overthink windows. Afternoon ENE goes cross and softens it — morning's your session.

daysToWatch.note: This is the one. Well overhead-plus to 5.5ft on a prime SSE angle. Wind is cross to cross-on rather than clean, but that's a real swell — shortboard day, rearrange plans and be there early before it builds through onshore E.
Still solid at 3-4ft on a prime angle with NE cross-off at dawn, though it's a stiff 18mph. Early morning before the wind swings E is the play — shortboard.
Overhead-ish 3.5-4ft at a longer 6.5s on a good angle, NNE cross-off at dawn easing to lighter ENE morning. Clean size — surf early before the afternoon SSE onshore turns it.
